description: Decision rules that link a measured gap to a measure from the national implementation roadmap 2026-2031. The rules decide; the AI model only explains the result. Every proposal is something to evaluate, not a proven remedy: the data shows where a gap is, not what causes it.

group_gap.description: A gap measured directly between two population groups for all of Finland (evidence type A), newest full year only.

fields.robust: yes if the 95 % confidence interval of the gap lies above zero, otherwise no

pathway_data.description: Whether open data exists for the stages referral, diagnosis and start of treatment.

fields.pathway_data_missing: yes if at least one of these stages has no open data, otherwise no

region_below_target.description: A wellbeing services county that is clearly below the 80 % participation target in at least one screening programme.

fields.language_level: disadvantaged if the county is in the third with the most other-language speakers, otherwise middle or advantaged
fields.education_level: disadvantaged if the county is in the third with the lowest education level, otherwise middle or advantaged

region_access.description: Every wellbeing services county, whatever its screening participation.

fields.primary_care_access_level: disadvantaged if the county is in the third with the longest waits for a non-urgent doctor appointment
